name: OKC_TEMPLATE_USAGES_H
description: This entity will contain relationship between template and document where it is used.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Business document type. Foreign key to okc_bus_doc_types_b

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Business document header id. Foreign key to various business document header tables

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number of the Template Usage

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Version Type of the Object. It can have following values "C"urrent , "A"mendment and "H"istory.

columns.name: AUTHORING_PARTY_CODE
columns.description: Indicates which party of the contract was the author of the contract terms.  Refers to the column OKC_RESP_PARTIES_B.RESP_PARTY_CODE.

columns.name: CONTRACT_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the current source of contract terms for the business document. Valid values are STRUCTURED, ATTACHED. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE=OKC_CONTRACT_TERMS_SOURCES

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Template used. Foreign key to okc_terms_templates_all

columns.name: DOC_NUMBERING_SCHEME
columns.description: Numbering scheme used in a document

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Business Document number for which Terms and Conditions exist in this table

columns.name: ARTICLE_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Clause effectivity date that is used to filter clauses from library

columns.name: APPROVAL_ABSTRACT_TEXT
columns.description: This is the textual content of the abstract that would be sent as part of deviation report during approval

columns.name: AUTOGEN_DEVIATIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if deviations should be autogenerated for this business document.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: Original system reference code to indicate the original source

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: Identifier1 of the Original system reference code

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Identifier2 of the Original system reference code

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_CHANGE_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: This flag is used to determine if contract source is allowed to be changed.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ADMIN_ID
columns.description: ID of the Contract Administrator.  This is the Person_Id from the PER_ALL_PEOPLE table

columns.name: LEGAL_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: ID of the Legal Contact. This is the Person_Id from the Per_All_People table

columns.name: LOCK_TERMS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the structured Terms are locked

columns.name: ENABLE_REPORTING_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the Structured Terms are to be used when the Contracts Terms are represented as Attached Document

columns.name: LOCKED_BY_USER_ID
columns.description: User_Id of the user locking the structured contract terms

columns.name: EXPERT_LAST_RUN
columns.description: Stores the time stamp when Contract Expert was last run.

columns.name: PENDING_VARIABLES
columns.description: Stores the number of unresolved user-defined variables in Contract Terms for a given business document like Purchase Order.

columns.name: PRIMARY_DOC_MERGEABLE_FLAG
columns.description: When the Contract Source is Attached, stores if the attached document is mergeable - i.e. if the Attached Document was generated by Oracle Contracts originally.

columns.name: TERMS_CONTENT_IN_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html content of the Terms and conditions pertaining to a Contract Template or a business document like Purchase Order.

columns.name: TERMS_CONTENT_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: Stores the time stamp when the data in TERMS_CONTENT_IN_HTML was refreshed.

columns.name: NONSTANDARD_CLAUSES
columns.description: This column stores the count of non-standard clauses in contract terms for a given business document like Purchase Order.

columns.name: SIMPLE_CONTRACT_TEXT
columns.description: This column stores the HTML content of the simple contract terms

columns.name: SIMPLE_CONTRACT_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether contract is simple or not

columns.name: SKIP_PRINT_AMENDMENTS_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to print amendment summary in preview or not
